definitions.sequence_copy: Repeated key/value sequence continuation; related computations can occur in natural training text.
definitions.spatial_inverse: Infer the inverse of left/right or above/below when the queried entities reverse.
definitions.weekday_successor: Next weekday in sequence or yesterday/today prose; historical H1041 formats were adaptive.
definitions.role_binding: Identify the agent under agent/patient swaps in active/passive clauses. Related to trained entity binding, but distinct operation/templates.
definitions.tense: Yesterday/Tomorrow cue with was/will answer contrast; differs from trained explicit past-tense lexical lookup. Open completion is non-unique.
definitions.continent_recall: Country-to-continent retrieval, related to trained country/capital/language facts. Historical America label is broad; not a unique-answer benchmark.
definitions.object_function: Object-to-use/purpose completion. Labels may be broad, nonunique or syntactically awkward; retain failures.

selection: First four source slots of each A/B historical manifest; all four weekday pairs of each historical sequence/prose format. Selected without reading outcome scores.
scope: Verifies current explicit causal training inventory and historical80-pair panel, not absence of related computations from natural-text fitting or LM pretraining. All seven families have historical evaluation exposure; no pristine/new-task claim. No new native inference or training in this builder.
